name: Customer Feedback Sentiment Analysis (Qwen Verification)
description: Evaluates whether the agent accurately classifies a highly positive customer review into structured JSON matching the sentiment schema.

input.text: The delivery was lightning fast and the quality exceeded all my expectations! Highly recommended.

customer_messages: Analyze the sentiment of this feedback and return valid JSON with keys: sentiment (POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL), score (0.0-1.0), confidence, and summary: 'The delivery was lightning fast and the quality exceeded all my expectations! Highly recommended.'

tool_contracts.name: echo_tool
tool_contracts.description: Echoes back input payload for diagnostic testing.

assertions.name: Sentiment JSON Schema Compliance
assertions.description: Validates that agent output contains required sentiment fields with correct types.

assertions.name: Execution Completed Cleanly
assertions.description: Ensures agent finished without timeout or unhandled exceptions.
